summary: Frontend regression for simplified Intl Shipments overview (4-tile filter buttons + shipments board + Open Orders tab + New Shipment). Empty-creds login -> Intl Shipments loads. Tiles render 3 / 1 / 2 / 2,670 as expected. All specified selectors and flows behave correctly. 0 DOM-nesting warnings from nested <em> inside <button> tiles, 0 page errors, 0 console errors, 0 horizontal overflow at 1920/1280/390 widths.

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 463 lines and still mixes list, overview, detail (~180 lines) and modals. Consider extracting Detail into its own file.
is-attn-ignore-IS-0010 cannot be independently verified once is-act-ignore-all runs earlier in the same session. Run this assertion BEFORE is-act-ignore-all or add a dev reset.

Nested clickable <em class='is-tile-link'> with onClick inside <button class='is-tile'> is valid HTML (em is phrasing content) and produced 0 React DOM-nesting warnings, but it is semantically fragile — a nested interactive element inside a button is not fully accessible (keyboard-focus reaches only the outer button). Consider restructuring the tile as a non-button container (div) with an explicit inner <button> for the tile filter and separate inner <button>s for actions/links, so each interactive is independently focusable.
is-kpi-released testid label ('released') is semantically 'awaiting prepayment / focus prepay' — consider renaming to is-focus-prepay for testid clarity.
